quote.zh: 你無法預先把人生中的點點滴滴串連起來，只有在回顧時，你才會明白它們是如何連在一起的。
quote.en: You can't connect the dots looking forward; you can only connect them looking backwards.

source.zh: 史丹佛大學畢業典禮演講，2005

quote.zh: 心中有了為何而活的理由，幾乎什麼樣的痛苦都能忍受。
quote.en: Those who have a 'why' to live, can bear with almost any 'how'.

quote.zh: 在告訴生命你打算拿它做什麼之前，先聽聽它打算拿你做什麼。
quote.en: Before you tell your life what you intend to do with it, listen for what it intends to do with you.

quote.zh: 別問這世界需要什麼，問問是什麼讓你感到活著，然後去做。因為這世界需要的，正是活過來的人。
quote.en: Don't ask what the world needs. Ask what makes you come alive, and go do it. Because what the world needs is people who have come alive.

quote.zh: 知之者不如好之者，好之者不如樂之者。
quote.en: They who know it are not equal to those who love it, and they who love it are not equal to those who delight in it.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

quote.zh: 吾生也有涯，而知也無涯。
quote.en: My life has a limit, but knowledge has none.

quote.zh: 沒有什麼比心中藏著一個未曾說出口的故事更折磨人了。
quote.en: There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you.

source.zh: 我知道籠中鳥為何歌唱
source.en: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
